description: Ask Cofounderbase to introduce the user to up to 5 agencies. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for an introduction and gives their own name and email. Required: requester_name, requester_email, project_brief (min 10 characters) and agency_slug or agency_slugs (legacy name/email/brief also accepted). A person reviews every request; the user gets one confirmation email.

requester_email.description: The user's email, used only to make the intro
